senses.definition: One of the bones, usually bearing teeth, which form the framework of the mouth.
The part of the face below the mouth.

senses.definition: (figuratively, especially in the plural) Anything resembling the jaw (sense 1) of an animal in form or action; the mouth or way of entrance.
examples: the jaws of a pass; the jaws of darkness; the jaws of death.

senses.definition: A notched or forked part, adapted for holding an object in place.
examples: the jaw of a railway-car pedestal.

senses.definition: One of a pair of opposing parts which are movable towards or from each other, for grasping or crushing anything between them.
examples: the jaws of a vise; the jaws of a stone-crushing machine.

senses.definition: (nautical) The inner end of a boom or gaff, hollowed in a half circle so as to move freely on a mast.
(slang, dated) Impudent, abusive, or worthless talk.
